cohort: The study included 186 neonates admitted to a neonatal intensive care unit with a history of meconium stained liquor or meconium staining of the umbilical cord.
finding: In this descriptive case series of neonates with meconium-stained liquor or umbilical cords, 70.97% developed Meconium Aspiration Syndrome, with 86.4% experiencing respiratory distress, 67.4% having abnormal x-ray findings, and 34.8% resulting in death.
